mapper.sql: ( r.resource_type = 'file' AND f.file_status = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c INNER JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table ancestor_node ON ancestor_node.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.descendant_id = f.file_node_id AND c.user_id = f.file_author_id AND ancestor_node.node_status IN ('trashed', 'deleted') ) ) OR ( r.resource_type = 'folder' AND d.node_status NOT IN ('trashed', 'deleted') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c INNER JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table ancestor_node ON ancestor_node.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.descendant_id = d.node_id AND c.user_id = d.node_user_id AND ancestor_node.node_status IN ('trashed', 'deleted') ) )
mapper.select: SELECT r.share_resource_id, r.share_id, r.resource_type, r.file_id, r.node_id, r.created_at, COALESCE(f.file_name, d.node_name) AS resource_name, COALESCE(f.file_size, 0) AS resource_size, f.file_type AS file_type FROM pcd_share_resource_table r LEFT JOIN pcd_file_info_table f ON r.file_id = f.file_id AND r.resource_type = 'file' LEFT JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table d ON r.node_id = d.node_id AND r.resource_type = 'folder' WHERE r.share_id = #{share_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND () ORDER BY r.created_at ASC

SELECT r.share_resource_id, r.share_id, r.resource_type, r.file_id, r.node_id, r.created_at, COALESCE(f.file_name, d.node_name) AS resource_name, COALESCE(f.file_size, 0) AS resource_size, f.file_type AS file_type FROM pcd_share_resource_table r LEFT JOIN pcd_file_info_table f ON r.file_id = f.file_id AND r.resource_type = 'file' LEFT JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table d ON r.node_id = d.node_id AND r.resource_type = 'folder' WHERE r.share_resource_id = #{share_resource_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ()
SELECT DISTINCT share_id FROM pcd_share_resource_table WHERE file_id = #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND resource_type = 'file'
